name: table-41
description: Budget versus actual table with variance coloring and a totals footer.

files.content:
import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableFooter, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" import { cn } from "@workspace/ui/lib/utils" const lines = [ { category: "Payroll", budget: 84000, actual: 82450 }, { category: "Marketing", budget: 12000, actual: 14320 }, { category: "Software", budget: 6500, actual: 6120 }, { category: "Travel", budget: 4000, actual: 5210 }, ] const fmt = (n: number) => (n < 0 ? "-" : "") + "$" + Math.abs(n).toLocaleString() export default function BudgetVarianceTable() { const totalBudget = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.budget, 0) const totalActual = lines.reduce((s, l) => s + l.actual, 0) return (
Category Budget Actual Variance {lines.map((line) => { const variance = line.budget - line.actual return ( {line.category} {fmt(line.budget)} {fmt(line.actual)} {fmt(variance)} ) })} Total {fmt(totalBudget)} {fmt(totalActual)} {fmt(totalBudget - totalActual)}
) }
